messages:
maya: Quick check — planning to flip the new precision gate tomorrow 08:00 PST. Int8 to be enabled for short-context profiles at 20% sample across non-enterprise orgs; fp16 to be enabled for enterprise/reserved GPU pools at 50%. Need ✅ on guardrails, rollback windows, and telemetry hooks before we click.

alex: +1 on schedule. Couple of quick asks:
- What's the exact flag name?
- Who's owning the automatic rollback trigger?
- Are we sampling by org or by route? :thinking_face:

maya: Flag is `quant_precision_gate_v3`. Rollback trigger I propose: 30m sustained p95 latency increase >20% OR generation divergence score increase >3pts on our eval set. Sampling is by org, then by route.

priya: Can we add an additional safety: exclude any org with active canary=true label and exclude SSO-integrated billing accounts from the 20% sampling? Last time a billing-heavy tenant saw token inflation.

ben: Agree with priya. Also recommend metric guardrail: token-per-request increase >10% for 15m window. If any of the three triggers fire, we flip to fallback model `fp16-safe-2025-03` and create a paging alert to eng-oncall.

maya: ok noted: triggers = p95 latency, divergence score, token-per-request. Fallback model and paging. Who wires the alert?

alex: I'll add the alert to the rollout playbook. Will create an alert rule in Grafana: `quant_rollout_health` with the three conditions, set to page eng-oncall + eng-ml on priority.

priya: Also adding a short smoke eval to run every 5m during the first 2 hours post-flip: sample 50 requests across each sampled org and run quick BLEU-ish + hallucination heuristics. If >5% failures, auto rollback.

maya: love that. pls add the smoke eval to the deployment job. Small config snippet for the flag (for code review):

```yaml
flag: quant_precision_gate_v3
audience:
  sample_by: org
  sample_pct: 20
  exclude_labels: ["canary", "billing-sensitive"]
profiles:
  - name: fp16-enterprise
    enabled_for: ["enterprise_tier"]
    min_gpu_ram_gb: 40
  - name: int8-short
    enabled_for: ["all"]
    context_max_tokens: 512
```

ben: small nit: add `grace_period_minutes: 15` so we don't trigger on cold-start blips. Also ensure KV-cache warmup is enabled for fp16-enterprise profile.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: staging/quant_precision_gate_v3 at maya@repo/feature/quant-gates (sha: ab12cd). Staging rollout will run 08:00 PST for 30m.

maya: thanks — action items:
- alex: create alert rule + paging (ETA: 2h)
- ben: add grace_period + KV warmup config (ETA: today)
- priya: add smoke eval job to deployment pipeline (ETA: EOD)
- maya: open PR with flag config + rollout docs (link when ready)

alex: ping me on the PR for a quick review. I'll try to get the alert in before staging starts. :rocket:

priya: I'll wire the smoke eval as a step in the CD pipeline and add results to the rollout dashboard.

maya: If no objections by EOD I'll proceed with the scheduled flip. Otherwise call it out here. :eyes:
